official_definition: (Your Attack Step) While there is 20px (Soul Core) on this Spirit, this Spirit can target and attack an opposing Spirit/Ultimate. When you do, this Spirit doesn't exhaust.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Infinite Blade] or [Infinite Blade: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Infinite Blade]", "give [Infinite Blade]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Enables direct targeting of opposing Spirit/Ultimate during attack step.
